combo_box.name: FlycamDroneResumeMomentum
combo_box.tool_tip: After alt-tab or when another camera hands back: Stop = start still; Keep = carry on at the camera's last on-screen speed

panel.text: Trigger mode is shown on the General tab. Non-XInput pads use Drone sticks in Assist cruise with no brake; their mapped triggers keep the existing DirectInput behavior.
